flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: FMCG is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.54) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: The company expects H2 to perform better than H1, particularly driven by the newly launched Oil segment.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, H2 will be better in the Oil. So, that will be picked up very well. So, H2 will be better than H1." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company expects to maintain a growth rate that is better than its past three years.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "But the growth will be maintained as the past growth will be maintained better than that." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company is planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on puja articles, devotional goods, and festival related items.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans to install a manufacturing plant for Soya Chunks after two quarters.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "After one shield kit, just standard shields, we will go for the plant. Install the capacity later, after 2 quarters." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
Rising institutional interest can keep supporting the price.
opportunities.evidence: POSITIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change 0.2 pp

opportunities.point: A fmcg tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
The company stated that the demand environment continues to be encouraging.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company sees huge market potential for its newly launched products.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "And if you see the current market, the market is a huge market potential." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 10 -> 16 Cr (Mar 2026) but operating cash flow -2 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -14 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The company is facing a tough time and slower revenue speed in Maharashtra due to established brands.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Even we are expanding the geographical also, but as we launched in the Maharashtra, so we are having a very tough time in the Maharashtra. So, we are not getting that much of revenue speed, what we wanted." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

threats.point: The company noted that geographical expansion is tough and can dent profitability and network building.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Because when we go for the placement of the new product in a new region, it will be quite tough. It will take at least a year to get the proper placement also. So, it will dent our profitability as well as the network also, to build the network." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
Historically weak quarters (Mar) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: No quadrant dominates - strengths, opportunities carry equal weight (S29/W19/O29/T23), so the evidence does not favour one side.
